# Rule 1.1 - Be Creative With Your Gimmicks
When playing a character with a specific gimmick — [color=#a41683][bold]Clown[/bold][/color], [color=#776d66][bold]Mime[/bold][/color], or otherwise — you should make a concentrated effort to add both variety and engagement with your respective gimmick.
## Precedents
This rule applies to both antagonists and crew-aligned individuals. Nobody enjoys your third tesloose, nor your third time stealing shoes. You should not rely on the same exact [italic]modus operandi[/italic] for all of your roles.
